description: Defines the ResourcePermission class for managing permissions (read, create, update, delete) within the OrangeHRM system, including methods for combining permissions and creating instances from arrays or DataGroupPermission objects.

classes.name: ResourcePermission
classes.description: Represents permissions for a resource, including methods to combine permissions and instantiate from arrays or DataGroupPermission objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ResourcePermission object with specified permissions.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.

methods.name: andWith
methods.description: Combines this permission with another using logical AND.

methods.name: orWith
methods.description: Combines this permission with another using logical OR.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission instance from an array of permissions.

methods.name: createFromDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Creates a ResourcePermission from a DataGroupPermission object.
